settings.repere: Paragraphe · Your body starts depleting its collagen
settings.text: Your body starts depleting its collagen levels as soon as you hit 25. And the rate at which you lose collagen (and muscle) accelerates with age, even if you continue to eat right and work out - robbing you of your strength & energy and leading to more visible wrinkles and skin that loses its firmness and bounce.
